proceedings.supporting_quote: On 8 December 2006 the court of first instance convicted the applicant of aggravated murder
On 27 June 2007 the Tbilisi Court of Appeal upheld the applicant’s conviction
On 20 February 2008 the Supreme Court declared an appeal on points of law lodged by the applicant inadmissible
On 3 November 2005 M.T. appealed to the regional prosecutor’s office against the investigator’s refusal to question him again
